mentions.name: Lightyard
mentions.description: A browser-based puzzle game inspired by Trainyard, an iOS puzzle game that stopped receiving updates and is no longer on the App Store. Rather than a direct clone, it offers a similar-but-distinct puzzle experience, ships with a base pack of puzzles, and lets players export puzzles they design and submit them for inclusion in the base pack.
mentions.problem: Trainyard ceased getting updates years ago and is no longer available on the App Store, leaving no way to play that puzzle game.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I came up with a variant on it and just put up https://www.geoffcanyon.com/lightyard.html I need more puzzles to include in the base pack, if you come up with something interesting, export it and send it to me!
mentions.author: gcanyon
